entries.source_text: 离开吧，笨蛋！我不久后就可以看着你的尸体哈哈大笑了。

entries.text: You little asshole! Who do you think you are to bother Dr. Wu? Stupid shithead!
entries.source_text: You little asshole! Who do you think you are to bother Dr. Wu? Stupid shithead!

entries.text: 你这个白痴！你以为你是谁，可以来打扰吴医生？愚蠢的白痴！
entries.source_text: 你这个白痴！你以为你是谁，可以来打扰吴医生？愚蠢的白痴！

entries.text: You have taken some wounds. I can fix that, dickhead, if you stay very still!
entries.source_text: You have taken some wounds. I can fix that, dickhead, if you stay very still!

entries.text: 你受伤了，我能医好它，笨蛋，前提是你要安静些！
entries.source_text: 你受伤了，我能医好它，笨蛋，前提是你要安静些！

entries.text: Five broken bones at least, and you've lost lots of blood. Being an idiot is hazardous to your health! You want to get fixed?
entries.source_text: Five broken bones at least, and you've lost lots of blood. Being an idiot is hazardous to your health! You want to get fixed?

entries.text: 至少有五处骨折，而且你失血太多。忠告：做个白痴有损你的健康！你还想医好吗？
entries.source_text: 至少有五处骨折，而且你失血太多。忠告：做个白痴有损你的健康！你还想医好吗？

entries.text: Depends on the definition of "fix." You can treat me, doc.
entries.source_text: Depends on the definition of "fix." You can treat me, doc.

entries.text: 基于“医好”的定义，你可以治疗我，医生。
entries.source_text: 基于“医好”的定义，你可以治疗我，医生。

entries.text: Me go.
entries.source_text: Me go.

entries.text: 我去。
entries.source_text: 我去。
